proof_roadmap.step: Decompose K_1 -> K_0 x K_0 into site coverings

difficulty_reason: Prove Cech^0(K,F) = F(X): write K_0 = {U_i -> X}, a covering of the site; K_1 -> K_0 x K_0 is a covering in SR(C,X), so K_1 = coprod_{i_0,i_1} {V_{i_0i_1j} -> X} with the map given by site coverings {V_{i_0i_1j} -> U_{i_0} x_X U_{i_1}}; then Cech^0(K,F) = Ker(prod_i F(U_i) -> prod_{i_0i_1j} F(V_{i_0i_1j})) with the obvious map, and the sheaf property of F identifies this kernel with F(X).
